description: INDEX-level trend structure, not single stocks: where the S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, STOXX 600 and EURO STOXX 50 sit against their 50/100/200-day averages, with a regime label and each region's profit trend. One symbol? get_stock_moving_averages.

include_history.description: Include the plotted [unix_seconds, value] price lines (close + the three averages per index). Default false — four lines across four indexes will trip the 10k-token-per-result warning, and the regime/stack/slope fields answer trend questions without them. The quarterly profits block ships either way.

index.description: Narrow to one index (its section only). Omit for all four.

window.description: Window the drawdown and the plotted price lines are measured over. Default 1y. The averages themselves are always full 50/100/200-day averages regardless, and the quarterly profits block is the same on every window.

name: get_momentum
